angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 485,599 km at 141.41 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.0717 +/- 0.0135 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 141.41 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.698 +/- 0.012 solar radii from Johnson et al. 2009, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...692L.100J/abstract): 485,599 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.75 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Johnson et al. 2009, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...692L.100J/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4675 +/- 100 K from Johnson et al. 2009, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...692L.100J/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Johnson et al. 2009, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...692L.100J/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-10.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.625, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-10 (pscomppars): spectral type K5 V, from Salz et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...576A..42S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-10 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.03 dex, from Johnson et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...692L.100J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-10 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.64029, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-10 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-10 (pscomppars): rotation period 11.91 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
